title: Reads
summary: Real Reads landing and studio UI, rendered with deterministic in-memory fixtures. Warm dark surfaces, soft blue accents and rounded controls remain app-owned.

direction.product: Reads turns a story, an essay or a letter into audio read in the voice of someone you love, with that person's permission.
direction.world: A bedside at night, with lamp light, a kept letter and headphones.
moments: The listener illustration on the landing
The finished listen in the studio, which is still a native audio bar and the next place to spend craft
direction.signature: The listener's slow sway. It is the only looping motion in the product and stops under reduced motion.
voice: Say what will happen in ordinary words, to one person, late in the day.
Use the product's words: a reading, a part, a recording, their voice.
Sentence case with no trailing period on headings, labels and buttons.
Name ElevenLabs only where words or a recording leave Reads.
